newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares close higher on Dow Jones rise.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares close higher on Dow Jones rise.

text.p: Manila shares edged higher in heavy trading on Tuesday, buoyed by the 50.68-point gain of the Dow Jones Industrial index, traders said.
The main index advanced 26.05 points, or 0.81 percent, to 3,259.72 points following Monday's 39.33-point climb.
"A lot of people are relieved the Dow Jones is continuing its runup," said Kerwin Lo of Abacus Securities Corp.
For the past few weeks, the local market was subdued by negative sentiment in Wall Street caused by worries over a possible hike in U.S. interest rates.
The market's gains was led by Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co which soared 60 pesos to 1,695 pesos, mirroring its $2.375-gain to $63.625 in New York on Monday.
Property stocks were hit by profit-taking on reports banks may have over-loaned to this sector, dealers said.
Nevertheless, Lo predicted the market will see more gains on Wednesday. "There seems to be a momentum," he said.
